notes: Catalog of OTA subsystem packages this server offers. The loader reads only `updates`.
Each entry's `file` is resolved under the data dir (ETCO_ota_dataDir); length + sha1 are
computed from the real file at startup, so an entry whose file is absent is skipped.
fromVersion '*' matches any installed version, with a loop-guard: a package is never offered
once the robot already runs toVersion. GetUpdateFrom serves the highest toVersion.
filter '' is a wildcard (matches whatever otaFilter the robot sends).
13.0.1 is the jibo.io repoint build of platform 13.0.0. It exists as a distinct, higher
version because a robot already running 13.0.0 would never be offered 13.0.0 again — the
loop-guard would suppress exactly the update that performs the repoint.
Not yet published: a skills package. The behaviour engine's own client copy lives in the
skills partition, so a complete repoint eventually needs one.

A stock robot sends otaFilter fcs (baked into jibo-ssm-normal.json). The source filter rule is a PREFIX match when the request carries a filter and an EXACT empty-string match when it does not, so ONE entry cannot serve both: filter  is NOT a wildcard. Every version is therefore published twice, once filterless and once as fcs, pointing at the same file.

updates.changes: jibo.io repoint build v7. Everything in 13.0.2, plus /etc/ssl/cert.pem -> certs/ca-certificates.crt: OpenSSL's compiled-in default CAfile, which the stock image never shipped. Without it the native Poco client in jibo-jetstream-service verifies against no roots at all and every hub connection fails ("certificate verify failed"), so the robot reaches Classic but cannot stream a single audio turn. Also: the CA-accepting jibo-server-client in all six copies with its CA beside each, and client configs world-readable so the unprivileged skill user can read them.

jibo.io repoint build v8. Everything in 13.0.3, plus two fixes a real OTA attempt exposed: (1) the OTA downloader (a separate Node 6 script from jibo-server-client) now passes an explicit CA, without which every update download failed instantly with UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY and a 0-byte file; (2) no HubClient.override is baked, because it wins over region-settings and forced every robot onto api.jibo.io -- the Classic entrypoint, not a hub -- so audio turns went to the wrong service. Each robot now resolves the hub for its own region.
